spec.description: What reaches the VPS and the Pi through Traefik: requests, errors and response times per service and router, TLS certificates and the proxy's own health. The Paths tab reads the access logs in Loki: which paths are requested, by which addresses, and with which answer.
Prometheus can scrape this Traefik's metrics endpoint.
spec.title: Status

spec.description: Bytes received from clients (up) and sent to them (down) on web and websecure.
spec.title: Traffic

spec.expr: label_replace(sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service",code=~"4.."}[$__range])) / sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range])), "service", "$1", "service", "([^@]+?)(?:-docker)?@.*")

label_replace(sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service",code=~"5.."}[$__range])) / sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (service) (increase(traefik_service_requests_total{instance="$instance",service=~"$service"}[$__range])), "service", "$1", "service", "([^@]+?)(?:-docker)?@.*")

spec.expr: topk(200, sum by (url, DownstreamStatus, RouterName) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))

count by (url, DownstreamStatus, RouterName) (sum by (url, DownstreamStatus, RouterName, ClientHost) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))

spec.description: The 200 busiest host and path combinations per answer and router, with how many addresses asked. Query strings are replaced by ?*. Ranges of more than about three days can hit Loki's series limit on the VPS; narrow them with Path, Address or Status.
spec.title: Top paths

spec.expr: topk(200, sum by (ClientHost, own) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))

count by (ClientHost, own) (sum by (ClientHost, own, url) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))

count by (ClientHost, own) (sum by (ClientHost, own, RequestHost) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))

sum by (ClientHost, own) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` | DownstreamStatus=~"401|403|404|429" [$__range]))

spec.description: The 200 busiest addresses: requests, distinct paths and hosts, refused requests. Own: a private address (LAN, WireGuard, Docker) or a basic-auth login; own traffic through Authelia on the VPS can't be told apart and counts as not own. Click an address to filter the tab by it or look it up.
spec.title: Client addresses

spec.expr: topk(100, sum by (request_User_Agent) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))

count by (request_User_Agent) (sum by (request_User_Agent, ClientHost) (count_over_time({service_name="traefik-access", host="$instance", router=~"$router", status_class=~"$status", own=~"$own"} | json | RequestPath=~`(?i).*$path.*` | ClientHost=~`${address:regex}.*` | label_format url=`{{.RequestHost}}{{.RequestPath}}` [$__range])))
